title: Course Window Sums
prompt: A course chart needs rolling totals. Write a function that returns the sum of every contiguous window of the requested size.

explanation.beginner:
Example: courseWindowSums([1,2,3,4], 2) produces [3,5,7]. Choose the numeric contribution of each record, then combine those contributions using the contract’s initial value.

Compare “handles exact window size”: input [[2,4,6],3] produces [12]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Choose the numeric contribution of each record, then combine those contributions using the contract’s initial value.

Tempting mistake: A count of records is not a sum of their values. Test empty input and a zero-valued record separately.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “handles exact window size”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
